question: In which year was the Indian Civil Service (ICS) officially replaced by the Indian Administrative Service (IAS)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1947**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Civil Service (ICS)**, often called the "**Steel Frame of British India**," was the premier civil service under British rule.
 
• After India's independence on **15 August 1947**, the **Indian Administrative Service (IAS)** was introduced to replace the ICS and serve the administrative needs of independent India.
 
• The transition from **ICS to IAS** began in **1947**, when the newly independent Government of India reorganized the civil service
